title: Golden sets: 15 clean + 5 adversarial synthetic cases per task
story: As the AI director I want golden sets large enough and adversarial enough that live model comparisons and prompt-injection resistance mean something
acceptance: Every task file in tests/fixtures/ai/golden/ has at least 15 clean cases and at least 5 adversarial cases (case field adversarial: true with attack: {kind, goal})
Labels (expected) are written from the task spec in src/ai/schemas.mjs and architecture/domain-model.md, never copied from local-provider or model output; each new case has a one-line labelRationale

Adversarial cases include paraphrased and obfuscated instructions that src/ai/guardrails.mjs sanitizeText does not strip (verified by a quick script you run and describe, not committed outside your path), each with the goal the attacker wants (e.g. atFault flipped, confidence forced high)
All data is synthetic and fictional (no real names, carriers, VINs or addresses); pii strings listed per case where relevant
node --test tests/unit/ai/ passes and node src/ai/eval.mjs still runs (the local baseline numbers will change; do not edit docs/ai-evaluation.md or src/ai/eval.mjs)
brief: Existing format: read two current golden files and src/ai/eval.mjs scoring (factSet/expectedSet). Keep existing cases and their recorded blocks; add new cases without recorded blocks. S5-AI-01 is changing output validation in parallel; keep outputs schema-valid per src/ai/schemas.mjs.
